tools.name: create_weekly_report
tools.description: Build a structured weekly client report (report ID, week start/end, accomplishments, hours, blockers, next-week plan) as data fields. Nothing is stored. Use when the report data will be processed or shown as fields. Do NOT use for a ready-to-send text version; use render_report_text.

tools.name: render_report_text
tools.description: Build a weekly client report from the same inputs as create_weekly_report and return it as plain text (header, accomplishments, hours, blockers, next week) ready to paste into an email or chat. Use when the user wants a readable report to send. Do NOT use when structured fields are needed; use creat

tools.name: report_templates
tools.description: List the built-in report layouts (freelancer weekly, agency client update, standup digest) and the sections each one covers. Use when the user asks what report styles exist or which sections to include. Do NOT use to build a report; use create_weekly_report or render_report_text.

tools.name: week_bounds
tools.description: Return the Monday-to-Sunday week containing a given date (UTC). Use to turn a date like 'Oct 2' into the week_start for a report. Do NOT use to build the report itself; use create_weekly_report or render_report_text.
